pages.title: Mystical Being
pages.description: Mystical Beings are the people and beings of the Mystical Legends Universe with mystical heritage and powers. This category gathers their wiki profiles and related articles.

pages.title: Mystical Legends Wiki
pages.description: Welcome to the Mystical Legends Universe: a world of Mystical Beings, elemental magic, hidden heritage, and intertwined journeys. Explore the stories and people that bring this universe to life.

pages.title: Character Relationships
pages.description: Explore the ties between characters in the Mystical Legends Universe. Select a character to see their documented connections and open their wiki page. Connections update from the character articles as the wiki grows.

pages.title: World Timeline
pages.description: Explore the history of the Mystical Legends Universe through its major arcs and connected events. The chronology is organized by story arc. Expand an arc’s events to read its history, character involvement, and related side stories, or use the contents to jump to a section.
